The handwriting was careful, the ink still faintly blue: If you find this, the tide was kinder than I expected. I am well. Tell my sister I kept walking. No name. No address. Elias read it twice, then folded it into his logbook beside the weather notes, and that night he set the lamp burning a little brighter than the rules required.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台刚刚冷却的机器。主干道的红绿灯仍尽职地变换，却只照着空荡的柏油。早点摊的蒸笼先醒了，白汽一缕缕爬到路灯底下；清洁车缓缓驶过，刷出一道湿亮的水痕。写字楼还有几格窗亮着，像不肯睡的眼睛。地铁口的风带着铁锈味，吹动一张被遗落的发票。天边尚未泛白，只有最东边的一层云被远处的霓虹染成暗红。整座城屏住呼吸，等着第一班公交车把它唤醒。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a job solves itself by doing one small piece and handing the rest of the same job to a smaller copy of itself.\n• It always needs a stopping rule, like counting down to zero, or it will keep going forever.\n• Think of hunting for your shoes: check your room, and if they aren't there, ask the very same question about the next room — until you find them or run out of rooms."}
